newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares end higher ahead of CPI data.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares end higher ahead of CPI data.

text.p: Italian shares ended firmer on Friday helped by the higher moves on other European bourses ahead of the final batch of preliminary CPI figures this afternoon, dealers said.

Despite the lower tone to Wall Street, Italian stocks held at firmer level after preliminary March CPI data indicated that inflation continued to fall, and news that Italy's 1997 mini budget will be unveiled next week.
The blue-chip Mib30 index ended 0.55 pct up at 17,436 while the all-share Mibtel was 0.55 pct higher at 11,795.

Preliminary CPI data from seven Italian cities Thursday indicated March month-on-month CPI rate of 0.1 percent and a year-on-year rate of 2.2 percent, from February's 0.1 percent and 2.4 percent. Four further cities report this afternoon.

Dealers said that they hoped the fresh data would point towards a rate of 2.2 percent for March, and would encourage a interest rate cut. Although a big cut was difficult to envisage with the lira weak, they added.
Among the blue chips, Fiat ended up 0.58 percent at 5,215 lire and Pirelli finished up 2.24 percent at 3,650 lire.
